title: Microsoft Teams: Show your shared content on both room displays
description: Make presentations easier to see from anywhere in the room, even when you're not in a Teams meeting. On Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android with dual displays, content you share through an HDMI connection can now appear on both screens at once. You can start or stop showing your content on both screens from the room controls. Admins can use settings to manage how this works in their rooms.
